final_message:
The fix has been applied successfully. The issue was that the condition `if len(cur) + extra > width - 1:` was incorrectly checking against `width - 1` instead of `width`. This caused words to be split prematurely because the check was evaluating to True when it should have been False for cases like "aaa bbb" fitting exactly into width 7.

The corrected code now checks `if len(cur) + extra > width:`, which properly prevents word wrapping when the total length would exceed the specified width.
